title: Cloud-Native Container & Linux Kernel Hardening
description: Master enterprise Linux kernel security, Seccomp system call filtering, AppArmor profiles, Linux Capabilities (CAP_SYS_ADMIN elimination), and runtime intrusion detection rules with Falco and eBPF.
objectives: Write custom Seccomp system call whitelisting profiles blocking dangerous syscalls (ptrace, reboot, mount)
Configure AppArmor profile enforcement to protect against container filesystem escapes
Audit and drop unnecessary Linux Capabilities (CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE)
Construct Falco runtime intrusion detection rules to detect rogue shell execution and reverse shells
Verify container immutability with ReadOnlyRootFilesystem policies
